text: Malta drives on the **left**.
NOTE: Cyprus also drives on the left.
text_zh: 馬爾他是**靠左**駕駛。
注意：賽普勒斯也是靠左駕駛。

text: Like most of Europe, Maltese licence plates have a blue strip on the left. However, unlike most of Europe, **short plates** are very common.
text_zh: 就像大多數歐洲國家一樣，馬爾他車牌左側有一條藍色飾帶。然而，與大多數歐洲國家不同的是，**短車牌**非常常見。

text: The general landscape of Malta consists of slightly hilly **dry agricultural fields**. Many roads are also only 1 or 2 lanes wide, due to the island’s size. Having a mediterranean climate, [cacti](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Kh2pMFPUTQhivKT76#extra%5Btags%5D=yes) and various [dry shrubs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/BqgdrBxdG2UFft3z7#extra%5Btags%5D=yes) can be seen.
text_zh: 馬爾他的整體地景由微坡的**乾燥農田**組成。由於島嶼的面積，許多道路也只有 1 或 2 個車道寬。由於擁有地中海氣候，可以看到[仙人掌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Kh2pMFPUTQhivKT76#extra%5Btags%5D=yes)和各種[乾燥灌木](https://maps.app.goo.gl/BqgdrBxdG2UFft3z7#extra%5Btags%5D=yes)。

text: **Limestone rock walls** are extremely common in Malta. This alone is usually enough to determine that you are in Malta.
text_zh: **石灰岩石牆**在馬爾他極為常見。光是這點通常就足以判定你在馬爾他。

text: The vast majority of buildings in Malta consist of low storey buildings, with **white to beige** coloured walls. Buildings made of [limestone](https://maps.app.goo.gl/BMSfQdQ7rujtEErg8#extra%5Btags%5D=yes) are also fairly common.
text_zh: 馬爾他絕大多數的建築都是低樓層建築，牆壁顏色從**白色到米色**不等。由[石灰岩](https://maps.app.goo.gl/BMSfQdQ7rujtEErg8#extra%5Btags%5D=yes)製成的建築也相當常見。

text: This style of traditional **covered balconies** is very common on Maltese buildings. They are often painted in bright colours.
text_zh: 這種傳統的**加蓋陽台**風格在馬爾他建築中非常常見。它們經常被漆成明亮的顏色。

text: The Maltese word for street is “**triq**”, which can be seen on almost every street sign.
text_zh: 馬爾他語的街道是「**triq**」，幾乎可以在每一個路名牌上看到。

text: **Bus stops** are a common sight in Malta. They may sometimes have useful information as to where you are.
text_zh: **公車站**在馬爾他是常見的景象。它們有時可能包含關於你所在位置有用資訊。

text: Like the UK and Ireland, Malta uses these distinctive **double yellow no parking lines**.
text_zh: 就像英國和愛爾蘭一樣，馬爾他使用這些醒目的**雙黃線禁止停車標線**。

text: **English** is the primary language of Malta.
text_zh: **英文**是馬爾他的主要語言。

text: Apart from English it is also common to see the **Maltese** language. Maltese uses the Latin script, but with unique letters, which include:
- Ċ ċ
- Ġ ġ
- Ħ ħ
- Ż ż
text_zh: 除了英文之外，看到**馬爾他語**也很常見。馬爾他語使用拉丁字母，但帶有獨特的字母，其中包括：
- Ċ ċ
- Ġ ġ
- Ħ ħ
- Ż ż

text: Regular metal guardrails are rare on Gozo Island. **Low stone barriers** are more common instead.
text_zh: 戈佐島上很少見到一般的金屬護欄。取而代之的是**低矮石欄杆**更為常見。

text: Uniquely, all bus routes on Gozo Island are in the **300s**. These can be quite hard to see, meaning they are most useful in moving games.
text_zh: 獨特的是，戈佐島上的所有公車路線都在**300開頭**。這些可能很難看清楚，這意味著它們在移動賽中特別有用。

text: These **blue signs** are unique to Valletta.
text_zh: 這些**藍色路標**是瓦etta（Valletta）獨有的。

text: This trekker on a ship that is painted **white and blue** can be seen between the main island and Gozo Island.
text_zh: 這個位於漆成**白藍相間**船隻上的徒步拍攝可以在主島和戈佐島之間看到。
